name: MonarchAiArtifactCard
title: AiArtifactCard
summary: The compact card a reply shows for an artifact it made: one button with the title, kind and version that opens the artifact.
whenToUse: In an AI conversation, where a reply produced a document, code, a table, a chart, an image or a web page.
whenNotToUse: For a file the person attached use a file component. For a general tappable card put a MonarchCard in a Button.
api: init(_ title: String, kind: MonarchAiArtifactKind, version: Int, description: String? = nil, isActive: Bool = false, kindLabel: String? = nil, versionLabel: String? = nil, actionLabel: String? = nil, action: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void)
enum MonarchAiArtifactKind { case document, code, table, chart, image, html }

options.name: kind
options.description: What the artifact is, which selects the icon and the kind name.

options.name: isActive
options.description: Whether the artifact is the one currently on show.

options.name: kindLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in name of the kind.

options.name: versionLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "v3", and "version 3" for VoiceOver.

options.name: action
options.description: Runs when the card is activated.

states.name: resting
states.description: A surface-coloured card with the default border; the icon tile and the action use the AI colours.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The subtle background and the AI border.

states.name: active
states.description: The AI-subtle fill, a 2-point AI border, and "Showing" in place of "Open".

states.name: disabled
states.description: Subtle background and border and the disabled text colour, set with disabled(_:).

appearance: A card with 12-point corners, at most 448 points wide. The icon tile is AI-subtle with the strong AI colour; the action text and chevron are the strong AI colour.
platformNotes: The web takes the artifact part of the conversation model; MonarchAiConversation is not built yet, so the card takes the title, kind and version directly. The parity map names MonarchCard as the base, but a card has no pressed or active state, so the surface is drawn by a button style with the card's radius. The web's hover state has no counterpart on touch.
accessibility: One button whose label reads the title, the kind, the version in words, the description and the action.
The artifact on show has the selected trait, reads "Showing" and has a heavier border, not colour alone.
The icon and chevron are hidden from VoiceOver; the chevron mirrors in right-to-left layouts.
The card is at least 44 points high.
Text scales with Dynamic Type and wraps; at the accessibility text sizes the action moves under the text.
edgeCases: A long title wraps; nothing is truncated.
An empty versionLabel removes the version from the visible line.
The card does not open anything itself; the action does.
